named_eddy_source_observations.interpretation: The authors map the Thor shedding event in January–June 2020 and describe detachment, reattachment, final separation, and westward propagation. The date bounds describe the paper's figure window, not a measured lifetime.
Satellite SST and concurrent drifter velocities support Thor being separated by this date; this does not establish that every later detachment was final.
Thor had deformed and nearly split into two eddies by this date; near-splitting is not a verified division into two independently named rings.
